# Traffic Light Manager
A traffic light management mod based on slyh/Cities2-TrafficLightsEnhancement
Mod-related information and usage tutorials can be found on 哔哩哔哩: https://space.bilibili.com/3546726445091690
## Feature
Customize the traffic lights at any intersection to look and work exactly the way you want.
* Traffic Light Group: Combine multiple small intersections into one large intersection, allowing you to create complex intersection layouts.
* Template System: Change all phases using the same template across all saves at once, and customize which template is used when creating new phases.
* Clipboard System: Copy the signal configuration of any lane connection (Edge or SubLane) to the clipboard and paste it to other lane connections, allowing you to quickly edit multiple intersections.
* Custom Name: Customize the names of intersections and phases, and optionally keep intersection names always visible on the world map.
* Display Current Phase: Always show the current phase, allowing you to know the current state of an intersection at any time.
* Sound Feedback: Provides sound feedback when hovering over buttons or pressing buttons.
In addition to these features, this mod includes many other thoughtful designs:
* When viewing an intersection, you can click another intersection to immediately switch the viewing target.
* Only the most useful features are included, without a complicated UI interface.

It is recommended to report issues on Github first, followed by the Paradox Forum.
Github > Paradox Forum > 哔哩哔哩(https://space.bilibili.com/3546726445091690) > Other
Wherever you report an issue, please make sure to describe it clearly.
* When reporting a bug, please provide as much detailed text description / game save files / screenshots / logs, or any other relevant information that can help identify the issue.
* When requesting a feature, please provide as much detailed text description / images, or anything else that can help clarify your request.
